changes.title: Open jaws
items: Animals open their jaws: wolves, lions, bears, crocodiles and the rest bite with their mouths open at the end of a wind-up and through a lunge, a legend roars as it wakes or turns, and a napping animal yawns as it gets up

changes.title: Art reds 2
items: The otter legend now stands like the others (creatures never go in the water), its stone and glowing pearl worn on a cord at its throat

Every area now has its own main tree: the crags' larches bent by the wind, mossy firs in the mistwood, stunted rowans on the icefall, ancient weeping birches in the trollwood and wind-bent junipers on the snowfield

changes.title: Bedroom version
items: The bedroom shows which version you're playing, small in its top left corner
